ENGLISH: Purge Pomerania from the History Books

The final piece of our war of liberation is to destroy the very concept of a Pomerania. As long as the idea of a Sorbian state exists we will never be safe, with the threat of the Sorbs rebelling to take back what they once stole from us. Every school, book, flag or song that mentions Pomerania will be banned, seized or destroyed. This land was once owned by the Emperor after defeating the Germans, and then it was retaken by the descendants of the displaced Germans. There was never a Pomerania.
